What we do

Our Services

Haven designs and installs premium CCTV, audio visual, networking and security systems for homeowners, self-builders and developers across Aberdeenshire, planned properly and finished cleanly.

CCTV

High-resolution CCTV for homes, businesses, retail and agricultural properties. Remote viewing on your phone, smart detection, no monthly subscriptions.

Home Technology

Premium AV, audio and technology systems designed around how you live, reliable, high quality and easy to use.

New Build Wiring

First-fix wiring through to final install for self-builds and developers. We plan and future-proof the technology from the ground up.

Multi-Zone Audio

Fill the whole house with sound, or just one room. Discreet in-ceiling speakers and multi-room audio, controlled from your phone.

WiFi & Networking

Whole-home Wi-Fi that actually works, built on wired access points. No dead spots, no dropouts.

Ajax Alarms

Professional-grade wireless alarm systems. Monitored security, remotely managed from your phone.

Starlink

Professional Starlink installation and WiFi distribution. Fast, reliable broadband for rural properties.

TV Mounting

Cable-free TV wall mounting. Clean, professional installations with fully concealed cabling.

Who we are

The North East's Trusted AV & Security Specialist

Haven Smart Home & Security is based in Inverurie and serves homeowners, developers and businesses across Aberdeenshire and the wider North East of Scotland. We install premium AV, CCTV, security and audio systems, each best-in-class, designed to work perfectly for your property. Formerly trading as Televise Ltd, serving the North East since 2019.

Ryan Mackie, Director: with over 15 years experience installing AV and security systems across the North East, every job gets Ryan's personal attention to detail.
Premium focus: we specialise in higher-end residential and commercial installations, built to a standard that lasts.
Free site surveys: most of our jobs start with a free site visit so we can recommend the right solution for your property.
Fully insured & VAT registered: professional, accountable and here for the long term.
